digest.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
digest.tldr: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

digest.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
digest.tldr: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.
